in_hindi.name: Aniketh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ani (without) + Keth (desire)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Aniketh एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Aniketh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Ani’ meaning ‘without’ and ‘Keth’ meaning ‘desire’. This name is believed to represent someone who is free from worldly desires.
